description: Labels for process-scoped, immutable loaded backend policy metadata, response schema_version 2 (Edge v0.9.13). Mode lists describe the final evaluation stage, not unconditional effective allows. Classifier meaning changes require versioned coordination.

provenance.note: Transcribed GET /backend-egress-policy labels, scope limits, v1 classifier, schema_version 2 and its local-enforcement guarantee rule; no raw CIDRs or credentials.

public_only_guaranteed_rule: True exactly when enforcement_scope=local-data-plane, mode=public and allow_cidr_overrides_present=false; always false for admission-only, unserved-namespace and no-data-plane. Deny overrides only restrict. Even a wholly public undisclosed allow list yields false. The dangerous-range flag alone does not certify public-only egress. schema_version 1 reported the policy-only value, including true on a public-mode CP.
consumer_rule: For public-only publication, recognize schema_version 2 and the complete classification/vocabulary, match the requested namespace, require local-data-plane and public_only_guaranteed=true, and check every serving DP after replacement/restart. Missing/unknown values, schema_version 1 or authorization failure block publication. CP admission-only metadata never attests its DPs.
